chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Sufyan ibn al-Simt, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
When the sun declines, the time of the two prayers has entered.

key_terms.الصَّلَاتَيْنِ: the two prayers, meaning Zuhr and Asr
key_terms.زَالَتِ: declined from the meridian; passed the zenith
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the legally recognized time for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When does the time for Zuhr and Asr prayers begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when the sun passes its zenith, the time for both Zuhr and Asr prayers begins. It is a jurisprudential report concerning the entry of prayer time and is significant in discussions of the timing and joining of the two daytime prayers.
